mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC for the FEDFUNDS trend signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating condition defined as the unemployment rate rising above 5.0% in a 3-month window signals potential economic slowdown and increased recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 5.0% in the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE threshold signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative equity sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS have declined over the prior 1 month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply contraction (INDPRO below 100.0), the S&P 500 underperforms as reduced output and inflationary pressures depress equity valuations, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO regime signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST has risen over the prior 1 month, or the Rank IC for the HOUST trend signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in core inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized inflation above 2.5%) signals potential monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC for the CPIAUCSL threshold signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery phase (PAYEMS growth rate above 0.5% monthly), the S&P 500 outperforms as employment gains support consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth rate is above 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC for the PAYEMS regime signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized inflation above 2.5%) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 2.5% and FEDFUNDS is above 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
